title: Browser climate lab
subtitle: Run a climate experiment with a sample or your own elevation map. The current model estimates annual and monthly temperatures.

trial.title: World climate lab
trial.subtitle: Start with this world's elevation and settings. The current model estimates annual and monthly temperatures without changing the world's climate layers.
trial.sourceHelp: The lab resamples this world's global elevation for a faster run. You can substitute another global heightmap.
trial.defaults: Some settings are missing from the world data and use Earth sample defaults. Check the inputs before running.
trial.saveHelp: The draft saves settings and resampled elevation in this browser's World data, but does not save the results.
trial.saveError: Could not save this climate draft. Check available browser storage or remove an older draft.

heightmap.title: Choose an elevation source
heightmap.start: A sample loads both the elevation map and its climate settings.
heightmap.drop: Choose or drop your own elevation map
heightmap.hint: PNG, JPEG, and WebP are supported. The image is resampled to 180 × 90. Grayscale values map to the elevation range in advanced settings.

action.loadingEngine: Loading and starting the browser runtime…

status.engineLoaded: Runtime ready. Reruns reuse it on this page. Initial load: {{seconds}} s.
status.previousResult: Showing the previous result. Run again to apply the current settings.

view.title: Climate results: temperature
view.placeholder: The first run may take longer while the browser loads the runtime. Once the result is ready, switch between annual and monthly maps without recalculating.

error.world: Could not load this world's global elevation. Check that the chosen planet and branch have an elevation map.
error.draft: Could not open this climate draft. It may have been deleted or saved in another browser.
error.sample: The elevation sample could not load. Retry or choose your own elevation map.
error.file: This elevation map could not be read. Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP file.
error.runtime: The browser runtime could not start. Retry, or open the technical details if it still fails.
error.compute: The climate experiment did not finish. Check your settings and retry.
error.params: Enter valid values and make sure the minimum elevation is below the maximum.

note: This preview uses a one-dimensional energy balance and a seasonal heat-capacity model. It does not calculate precipitation, winds, currents, or climate classes.
